description: Poll a discovery job by its jobId. Returns the lifecycle state (queued, processing, completed, failed, exhausted), `total_prospects` (the canonical count of validated prospects delivered so far — the SAME field name get_discovery_results carries, so you can group/count across both; `prospectsFound` is a deprecated alias of it) and `target` counts, and `found`: the prospect DOMAINS discovered so far — which accumulate PROGRESSIVELY while the job runs, so you see results before it finishes. For incremental polling, pass the previous response's `next_cursor` as `cursor` to receive only the domains added since your last poll (`has_more` stays true until the job reaches a terminal state; omit `cursor` to get the full list so far). Call get_prospect(domain) — or get_discovery_results once terminal — for full detail on any domain in `found`.
name: get_discovery_status
title: Get discovery status
